title: When LLMs Learn to be Students: The SOEI Framework for Modeling and Evaluating Virtual Student Agents in Educational Interaction
reasoning: The SOEI framework grounds its virtual student agents in 'moral-spiritual development' as a core dimension (Figure 2 and Section B.2.1). Additionally, the evaluation includes instructional tasks based on 'The Analects' of Confucius to assess the agents' ability to reflect and articulate moral values and ethical principles.
